verdict.rationale: Missive documents a first-party "Custom MCP" feature letting users add any MCP-compatible server URL with authentication so the AI Copilot can use its tools, plus ready-made MCP integrations (Notion, Linear, Attio, Lindy.ai) for building context-aware workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming custom MCP server connection works in practice (only vendor docs cited).
